jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Python and K8s
jobs.jd_full:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager - Python and K8s that is passionate about building a world-class devops culture in corporate information systems. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productise those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes.

As an engineering manager you’ll lead a team in your local time zone, focused on the business workloads that make Ubuntu, Canonical, and our various services highly available around the planet.You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

What you’ll do

  • You’ll lead a team focused on productising business workloads
  • You will build and manage a regional team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring, and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering by directly contributing toward your team’s goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have experience in Docker and Kubernetes operations
  • You have a software engineering background, with proven Python experience
  • You have experience developing Python frameworks, and understand the importance of stable consumable APIs
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience working in an agile development environment

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint
jobs.jd_full:
About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.

The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end. You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role. The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology. AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability. Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.

What You Will Own

  • The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
  • The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control. Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local models running offline - and capturing the prompts, pastes, uploads, and agent-executed commands that browser and network DLP cannot see.
  • Translating business vision into engineering reality. You turn signals from executives, sales, customers, competitors and the engineering org into a coherent technical roadmap. You are the interpreter between “we need to detect AI exfiltration” and “here is how we instrument the endpoint to see it.”
  • Building for the enterprise: bulletproof and undetectable. Enterprise customers expect the Agent to be invisible to end users, resilient against tampering, and reliable in conditions that break weaker products. You own the roadmap that keeps it that way.
  • Performance, footprint, and reliability. Every CPU cycle, megabyte and battery percent we consume is felt by the end user and argued about by the customer's IT team. You set and defend the performance bar.
  • Define, measure, and meet product KPIs. Adoption, rollout velocity, deployment success rate, crash rates, detection coverage, time-to-patch on OS changes. You set the numbers and hold the team and the company to them.
  • Industry and ecosystem relationships. Microsoft, Apple, the Linux ecosystem, MDM vendors, and the major AV and EDR vendors. You represent Teramind in technical conversations where the agent's architecture is the subject.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 owning a technical platform, SDK, agent, or systems-level product. This is a senior IC seat: influence without headcount.
  • Technical depth is non-negotiable. You do not need to write C++, but you should reason about Windows architecture, macOS system extensions, and the trade-offs between Endpoint Security and Network Extension frameworks. You can push back credibly in a design review.
  • You understand how AI actually runs on a computer. A hosted model in a browser tab, a native desktop client, an IDE-embedded assistant, a CLI coding agent, and a local model under Ollama are five different detection problems, and several are invisible to anything watching the network. You know why, and you know what an audit trail for an autonomous agent has to capture.
  • Endpoint or systems background. You have shipped endpoint security (EDR, EPP, XDR), monitoring or management agents, OS-level tools, or systems software. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender, Tanium and similar are directly relevant. Pure SaaS and application PMs without systems exposure will struggle here.
  • You think in outcomes, not features. Success is “95% of customers roll out a new agent version within 30 days,” not “shipped version 27.0.”
  • You are comfortable with security trade-offs. Visibility versus privacy, tamper protection versus usability, cloud processing versus on-device intelligence. You can hold the attacker's perspective and the IT buyer's perspective in the same conversation.
  • You work with AI, not just about it. You use AI in your own practice, prototyping to pressure-test concepts before spending engineering cycles, and evaluating model behavior rather than trusting vendor claims.
  • You bring rigor, and you write. PRDs, decision memos, prioritization frameworks, release cadence, credible engineering-facing specs. In a distributed team, writing is how product management scales.

Nice to Have

  • Engineering background earlier in your career: systems, kernel, driver, or low-level platform work
  • Windows Filter Drivers, Minifilters or WFP; macOS Endpoint Security or Network Extensions; Linux eBPF, kernel modules or userspace agents
  • MDM ecosystems (Jamf, Intune, Workspace ONE, Kandji)
  • Insider risk, DLP, or behavioral analytics
  • Local model runtimes and on-device inference (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
  • Agentic AI: tool calling, MCP, and autonomous coding or workflow agents
  • AI governance, AI security, or shadow AI discovery products
  • EDR and AV co-existence and exclusion lists at scale

Why This Role

Endpoint agents are having a moment. The convergence of insider risk, DLP, AI, and hybrid work is making the endpoint the most strategically important surface in enterprise security and workforce intelligence. Teramind's Agent is one of the deepest data-collection engines in the market - we see things the rest of the category does not - and it is one of the strongest competitive moats we have.

You are coming in to take a genuinely differentiated technical platform and make it the backbone of the next generation of workforce intelligence. The engineering talent is here. The customer demand is here. The strategic priority is here. Your role is pivotal to where Teramind goes next.

Interested?

We'd love to hear what you have shipped, what you have owned, and why this role fits what you want to do next. Send us your resume and a short note.

Compensation

Additional Information

About Us

At Teramind, we're pioneering a predictive, AI-driven approach to safeguarding organizations' people, data, and operations. As a global leader in user behavior analytics, insider risk management, and workforce intelligence, we empower businesses to transform data into a strategic asset - delivering clear visibility, control, and proactive protection across digital environments.

We're open to hiring in just about every country in the world! Feel free to apply even if you don't live in the country listed in the job description.

Benefits

This is a remote job. Work from anywhere! We’ve been thriving as a fully-remote team since 2014. To us, remote work means flexibility and having truly diverse, global teams.

Additionally:

• Collaboration with a forward-thinking team where new ideas come to life, experience is valued, and talent is incubated.

Our Recruitment Process

We don’t expect you to check every box on the list. If you can picture yourself contributing to this team, we want to hear your story!

Most roles move through three interviews, though some can move quicker with fewer rounds. Leadership and technical roles may move through a more thorough process with multiple interview stages. All roles require reference and background checks.

Equal Opportunity

Teramind is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, participate on an interview, or perform this role, contact hr@teramind.co.

jobs.title: [Contractor] Mid-level/Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Cheesecake Labs is an AI, data, and product engineering partner for established and scaling organizations navigating legacy systems, fragmented data, AI pressure, or limited engineering capacity.

Our services include AI Implementation, Application Modernization, Data & Analytics, Product Engineering, AI-Accelerated Delivery, and Embedded Engineering Teams. We deliver agentic workflows in 8-12 weeks and modernize applications in 5-10 months rather than 2 years. We also build trusted data foundations and digital products designed to scale. Our agentic software development lifecycle accelerates execution, while experienced engineers embed with client teams to provide technical depth, security, and clear ownership.

Member of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network; technology partners include Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and AWS.

Across 13+ years, Cheesecake Labs has built 300+ products for clients including Eurasia Group, MoneyGram, the World Bank, Stellar, Wedgewood, PepsiCo, Merck, Sodexo, and Mercado Libre.

The story behind this role

At Cheesecake Labs, product work usually starts before things are fully defined.

We’re often brought in when companies are still shaping ideas, validating opportunities, aligning stakeholders, or trying to understand what should actually be built — and why.

That’s why we maintain a network of strong contractor Product Managers we can engage quickly as new projects and client opportunities emerge.

This is not a traditional long-term internal role.

It’s a contractor opportunity designed for people who enjoy navigating ambiguity, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and helping turn business problems into valuable digital products across different industries and client contexts.

We’re looking for a Product Manager (Contractor) who combines product thinking, communication, organization, and client management in fast-moving international environments.

Engagement details

  • Contractor / project-based engagement
  • Paid in USD
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible allocation depending on project availability and fit
  • Opportunities may vary in duration, scope, and weekly commitment depending on client needs

Some opportunities may start immediately.
Others may become active as new projects enter our pipeline.

What this role actually looks like

This is not a “just manage backlog” type of role.

On a typical project, you might:

  • Work with clients and stakeholders to understand business goals, user problems, and product opportunities
  • Help shape product direction even when requirements, priorities, or product vision are still evolving
  • Create and organize product backlogs, user stories, business rules, and feature definitions
  • Work closely with delivery managers, designers, and engineers to define valuable, feasible, and usable solutions
  • Facilitate alignment across clients, technical teams, and business stakeholders
  • Participate in product discovery, roadmap discussions, prioritization, and go-to-market conversations
  • Join product ceremonies and help ensure the product is evolving in the right direction

Some projects will be highly strategic and discovery-oriented.
Others will be much more execution and delivery-focused.

Most are a mix of both.

What tends to work well here

We’ve seen that people who thrive in this type of engagement usually:

  • Have strong experience managing digital products across web and mobile environments
  • Feel comfortable navigating ambiguity, evolving priorities, and fast-changing product contexts
  • Know how to balance business goals, user needs, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Feel totally confident working in English with international clients and teams (calls, discussions, async) — at least advanced level
  • Operate well across multidisciplinary environments involving product, engineering, design, and delivery teams
  • Adapt well to consulting-style environments where different projects and industries require fast context-switching
  • Already use AI as part of their day-to-day workflow — whether for organization, discovery, documentation, research, prioritization, or workflow acceleration

Previous experience in consulting/service environments, enterprise products, or US-based client contexts is a strong plus.

This probably won’t be your thing if

Just to be transparent:

  • You prefer highly structured environments with very stable scopes and long planning cycles
  • You’re uncomfortable navigating ambiguity or balancing multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
  • You prefer operating only at a strategic level without involvement in execution and day-to-day product decisions
  • You’d rather avoid client-facing conversations or cross-functional collaboration
  • You rely heavily on mature product structures, large internal product teams, or extensive metrics environments to operate effectively

There’s nothing wrong with any of that — it’s just not how these engagements usually operate.

One last thing

To participate in this selection process, you must:

  • Have a valid business registration in your country (such as CNPJ, VAT, EIN, or equivalent)
  • Have a bank account eligible to receive payments in USD
  • Be able to issue invoices accordingly

These requirements are necessary for contractor engagement and payment processing.

Not sure if you check every box?

That’s okay.

We know that many great people — especially from underrepresented groups — hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the requirements.

If this opportunity sounds interesting, we’d still love to hear from you.

IMPORTANT TIP -> The communication during the selection process is done by email. We suggest that you keep an eye on your email inboxes and set the permission to receive messages from @cheesecakelabs.hire.trakstar.com so our messages will not be directed to the spam box ;)

The collected personal data will be used only to manage and control candidate resumes to assess the necessary requirements such as contact information, and conduct this selection process.

The collected data will not be shared with others (“third parties”) without your authorization, and their use will be restricted to Cheesecake Labs' internal staff, and also to the service providers that process your data for the selection process. At any time, you can contact us and we will remove your data from our data collection system. To do that, just simply send an email to .

jobs.jd_full:
Joining Collibra’s Product Marketing team

As a Sr. Technical Product Marketing Manager, you’ll be part of a cross-functional, highly collaborative team that works across Partners, Product, and Professional Services to bring data intelligence solutions to life. Reporting to the Director of Industry and Persona Marketing, you’ll lead joint go-to-market strategies with strategic partners and create impactful messaging and content that empower both Collibra and partner sales teams to succeed.

Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager’s at Collibra are responsible for

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Develop and execute technical go-to-market strategies by synthesizing deep market, competitive, and customer insights, with a strong focus on technical differentiators and use cases for our AI and unstructured data solutions.
  • Technical Messaging & Positioning: Define and refine differentiated technical messaging and positioning that highlights the unique capabilities and value of our products. This includes crafting narratives that resonate with data scientists, engineers, and technical leaders.
  • Content Creation: Create high-impact technical content, including solution briefs, whitepapers, technical blog posts, demos, and technical presentations. This content should be designed to educate, engage, and convert a technically-minded audience.
  • Product Launches: Lead and coordinate cross-functional product launches, working closely with product management, engineering, sales, and marketing to ensure a seamless and impactful launch of new technical features and products.
  • Sales Enablement: Equip our Sales, Solution Engineering, and Partner teams with the technical knowledge and content they need to effectively sell our AI and unstructured data products. This includes developing technical training materials, competitive battle cards, and detailed product documentation.
  • Industry & Customer Engagement: Act as a technical subject matter expert at industry events, webinars, and customer meetings. Present to and engage with technical audiences to showcase our solutions and gather critical feedback.
  • Product Tour: Help create and update engaging interactive guided tours of the Collibra Platform that explore real-world use cases and demonstrate the latest Collibra capabilities.

You have

  • Years of Experience: 7-10 years of technical product marketing experience, ideally in global technology companies.
  • Technical Acumen: A strong understanding of core concepts in data management, AI, machine learning, and/or unstructured data. Experience with related technologies is a significant plus.
  • Product Marketing Experience: Proven experience in a product marketing role, including developer relations responsibilities, preferably for a B2B enterprise software or SaaS company.

You are

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
Location

Our Product Operations Analyst - Product Analytics will be an integral part of our Global Product Management team.

This role is based remotely in the East US, the UK, Ireland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Estonia and Israel.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Product Operations Analyst to strengthen how R&D decisions are made at DoiT and to help drive our AI transformation across the organization.

This role is built for someone who cares deeply about business results, not just the data itself. You care about the customers we serve and use AI tools, data, and voice of the customer systems as tools to improve how we discover, define, build, mature, and iterate our products.

You’ll operate at the intersection of product, data, AI, and customer insight helping build and maintain the measurement and analytics foundations that ensure our product investments are grounded in reliable signals and real customer needs.

Reporting to the Head of Product Operations and part of the Product and R&D organization, this is a high-impact individual contributor role suited for someone with strong data, analytics, and AI experience who enjoys building scalable processes and working cross-functionally.

As DoiT’s product portfolio grows, clear measurement and structured customer insight become increasingly important. This role helps ensure that product decisions are informed, measurable, and aligned with business outcomes, enabling the team to build with greater confidence and focus.

Responsibilities

  1. Product Measurement & Instrumentation

Support and evolve the framework and systems  that turn product behavior into trusted, actionable signals:

  • Partner with Engineering to define and maintain event taxonomy, tracking standards, and instrumentation quality
  • Build and maintain scalable, self-service dashboards for product teams
  • Help establish and document clear metric definitions as a shared source of truth.
  • Contribute to improving how and what we measure as the product evolves.
  • Leverage AI to repeatedly unlock insights and recommendations from these signals

Outcome: Product teams have reliable data to evaluate performance and make informed decisions.

  1. Analytics & Data Foundations

Strengthen the product analytics ecosystem and data models that power decision-making.

  • Work within our product analytics stack (e.g., Mixpanel, Segment, Looker) to ensure accurate and accessible reporting.
  • Build and maintain dbt models for core product entities and behaviors.
  • Contribute to a clean, usable metric layer for business stakeholders.
  • Help structure and analyze Voice of the Customer inputs (e.g., support, churn, NPS, sales feedback, customer interviews)
  • Support data quality through testing, monitoring, documentation, and automation
  • Deploy the best AI tooling available to make our data a differentiator

Outcome: Product data is systematically consistent, accessible, and trusted.

  1. Insight Generation & Reporting

Translate product usage and customer signals into clear, actionable insights.

  • Deliver recurring product analytics reporting (adoption, engagement, retention)
  • Contribute to analytics readouts to business stakeholders and executives with clear findings and recommendations
  • Perform analyses that connect product behavior to revenue and retention outcomes
  • Support automated reporting and AI-assisted workflows while maintaining metric integrity
  • Strive to make insights and reporting automated and self-service, heavily assisted through best practices with emerging AI techniques

Outcome: Product and business stakeholders regularly use analytics and customer insights to inform roadmap and investment decisions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product analytics or related roles. Experience working closely with digital product teams and influencing decisions through data.

AI-First mentality. Must have a practical understanding of how AI is reshaping analytics workflows. The ideal candidate will have experience using AI to accelerate insight generation, documentation, and distribution while understanding how to build guardrails, trust, and safe operationalization of AI.

  • Systems thinker & operator’s mindset. Track record of building systems that scale across many groups.
  • A “Builder” mindset. We have bold ambition, and we move fast. Whether we’re missing processes, systems, tools, data, or buy-in, your instinct must be to create, solve, and build paths that may not exist today.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. Ability to prioritize, structure problems, and execute independently while collaborating across teams.

Clear communicator. Experience presenting analysis to product managers and business stakeholders, translating complex findings into actionable recommendations. Strong analytical foundation. Advanced SQL required. Experience with event-based analytics and familiarity with tools such as Mixpanel (or similar), Looker (or similar BI tools), Segment (or similar), and dbt. Domain familiarity (preferred). Exposure to public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), FinOps/cloud cost management, and enterprise SaaS company concepts is preferred.

How success will be measured

  • Product teams rely on analytics to evaluate feature performance and guide roadmap decisions
  • Core product metrics are clearly defined, trusted, and consistently used
  • Product insights contribute to improvements in adoption, engagement, and retention
  • Voice of the Customer signals are organized and incorporated into feedback loops
  • Data is readily accessible, well-documented, and clear, enabling efficient decision-making
  • Analytics and insights are available quickly and require less manual effort
  • AI is being used across our product operating model to incorporate signals into every decision across Product, Design, and Engineering
  • AI-driven insights are systematically integrated to inform and optimize critical decision-making throughout every phase of our product lifecycle, from initial concept to post-launch iteration.

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it’s our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are

Every organization runs on intelligence: years of accumulated knowledge, decisions, and context. As AI takes on more of that work, companies face a choice: rent that intelligence from vendors who keep the data, the context, and the results, or own it.

OpenTeams exists to make ownership possible.

Founded by Travis Oliphant, creator of NumPy and SciPy, and built by people with deep roots across the open-source ecosystem, including NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, and Jupyter, we help enterprises and governments build AI they control, govern, and evolve themselves.

If that sounds like your kind of work, we’d like to meet you.

Program Manager

Location: Washington, DC; Denver, CO; or Colorado Springs, CO preferred (hybrid). Highly qualified candidates outside these locations may also be considered for unclassified work .

Work Authorization: U.S. citizenship required

Clearance: An active TS/SCI clearance with CI polygraph is strongly preferred. Candidates without an active clearance may be considered for unclassified work but must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Salary Range: $145,000–$250,000 USD, dependent on experience level and location

About the Role

We’re looking for a Program Manager to run an AI/ML platform program supporting national security missions. This is a role for someone who has done milestone-based work before and understands that on a fixed-price program, the schedule is the budget.

You own execution end to end: cost, schedule, performance, milestone acceptance, contract deliverables, subcontractor performance, and risk and change management. You track Government dependencies and chase them down before they turn into slips. And you hold the day-to-day relationship with the Government program office — you’re who they call, and you’re who comes back with the answer.

Our program teams are intentionally small and senior. There’s no layer between you and the work, which means the things that actually keep complex programs moving — surfacing dependencies early, documenting decisions when they’re made, escalating risk before it’s a problem — are yours to do, not to hand off.

This position is contingent upon contract award. Travel of up to 25% may be required, primarily to Government facilities and between company locations. Classified work and certain Government engagements require an appropriate clearance and onsite presence in an accredited facility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own program cost, schedule, performance, and execution throughout the period of performance
  • Develop and maintain the integrated program schedule and drive milestones to Government acceptance
  • Manage contract deliverables, including technical reports, architecture documentation, recurring status reports, and program risk records
  • Ensure deliverables meet contractual deadlines, quality expectations, and documented acceptance criteria
  • Track Government-furnished equipment, information, access, and personnel dependencies against required dates
  • Document and escalate late or at-risk Government dependencies, including anticipated schedule impact and proposed remedies
  • Manage subcontractor and vendor performance, deliverables, staffing, and invoicing as part of an integrated program team
  • Coordinate cleared subcontractor personnel and professional services engagements
  • Support facility and personnel security processing and coordinate the security onboarding of program staff
  • Maintain the program risk register, decision log, assumptions, issues, and mitigation plans
  • Manage material scope, schedule, or dependency deviations through documented change-management processes
  • Support requests for equitable adjustments or other contractual remedies when appropriate
  • Serve as the primary programmatic interface to Government program and contracting stakeholders
  • Coordinate activities across multiple Government stakeholder organizations
  • Prepare for and lead program reviews, milestone reviews, status meetings, and executive briefings
  • Partner with technical leadership to translate engineering progress, constraints, and risks into clear program-level reporting

Required Skills & Experience

  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
  • 8+ years of program or project management experience supporting Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or comparable Government programs
  • Direct ownership of cost, schedule, performance, and milestone acceptance for firm-fixed-price or milestone-based delivery
  • Experience managing programs awarded through Other Transaction authority, Commercial Solutions Opening processes, or comparable rapid-acquisition vehicles
  • Experience managing Government-furnished dependencies and formally escalating Government actions that affect contractor performance or schedule
  • Experience managing subcontractors as part of an integrated program team, including personnel, deliverables, performance, and invoicing
  • Working knowledge of Risk Management Framework accreditation timelines and the program dependencies associated with achieving an Authority to Operate
  • Experience maintaining program schedules, risk registers, decision logs, change records, and formal contract deliverables
  • Strong written communication skills suitable for Government correspondence, program reviews, contractual deliverables, and executive reporting
  • Ability to communicate effectively with Government program officials, contracting stakeholders, technical leaders, security personnel, and subcontractors
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI polygraph
  • Project Management Professional certification or an equivalent program-management credential
  • Experience delivering AI/ML platforms, analytics systems, or software capabilities into classified environments
  • Experience working for a nontraditional defense contractor or commercial software company serving Government customers
  • Familiarity with facility-clearance processing and DD Form 254 administration
  • Experience managing personnel-security and classified onboarding activities
  • Experience supporting defense innovation organizations or rapid prototyping initiatives
  • Experience coordinating programs involving multiple agencies or Government stakeholder organizations
  • Technical familiarity with cloud platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, or software delivery programs

What We Offer

  • Medical, Dental & Vision – 100% paid for employees, 75% for dependents
  • 401(k) Match – Up to 5% with full vesting after 2 years
  • Unlimited PTO – With a required minimum of 15 days off annually
  • Fully Remote Setup – Includes up to $3,000 equipment reimbursement
  • Continuous Education –  Includes up to $500 reimbursement
  • Disability & Life Insurance – 100% employer-paid
  • HSA & FSA Options – With monthly HSA contributions from OpenTeams

Grow With Us

At OpenTeams, growth isn’t just about the company—it’s about you.

We believe the best careers are built at the edge of your potential. That is where new tools, ideas, and technologies change the world. Here, you’ll work alongside pioneers of AI, solving problems that matter: making AI more transparent, more ethical, and more empowering. As your skills grow, our career framework provides a pathway and recognition of that increased impact.

Opportunities aren’t limited by geography. You’ll collaborate with global experts, contribute to open source projects that power the world’s technology, and stretch your skills daily.  That global perspective and diversity makes our solution more universal and robust.  We are committed to continuing to celebrate diversity on our team.

Supported people are successful people.  We offer 100% employer paid medical premiums for employees and self-managed PTO with a minimum time off requirement, so that our teams are able to do their best work.
